content: मानिन् {%a.%} [मान-इनि, मन्-णिनि वा] .²1 Fancying, considering, regarding (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); as in पण्डितमानिन्, अनूचानमानी <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 Honouring, respecting (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .²3 Haughty, proud, possessed of self-respect; पराभवोऽप्युत्सव एव मानिनाम् <ls>Ki. 1. 41</ls>; परवृद्धिमत्सरि मनो हि मानिनाम् <ls>Śi. 15. 1</ls>. .²4 Entitled, to respect, highly honoured; मानिनो मानयेः काले <ls>Bk. 19. 24</ls>. .²5 Disdainful, angry, sulky. .²6 Being regarded or considered as. --{%m.%} A lion. .{@-नी@} .²1 A woman possessed of self-respect, a strong-minded, resolute, or proud woman (in a good sense); चतुर्दिगीशानवमत्य मानिनी <ls>Ku. 5. 53</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 38</ls>. .²2 An angry woman, or one offended with her husband (through jealous pride); माधवे मा कुरु मानिनि मानमये <ls>Gīt. 9</ls>; <ls>Ki. 9. 36</ls>. .²3 A kind of odoriferous plant.
